# MotionVfx Live 0.8.5

An in-game action and VFX editor for **Monster Hunter Wilds**, with a REFramework-D2D interface and an AI MCP interface.

## Download and installation

Download **`MotionVfxLive-0.8.5-Setup.exe`** below. Close the game, run the installer and choose the directory containing `MonsterHunterWilds.exe`. A working REFramework installation is required. The installer includes the editor, D2D component, native input component, AI MCP server and a self-contained .NET runtime; no separate SDK, Python or .NET installation is needed by end users.

Existing installations can be updated in place; installing the same version repairs it. Program files are backed up before replacement. Cleanup is limited to recognized, unchanged old program files verified against their package manifest. User assets, exports, settings, notes, other mods, and unknown or user-modified files are preserved. REFramework itself is not replaced.

## Included features

- Capture actual player actions and their triggered VFX resources, edit EFX entries and attributes, and apply edits for preview in the running game.
- Grouped XY/XYZ and color controls, Chinese/English property labels, group notes, entry/attribute removal, and file export.
- Separate action, effect, time and PFB editing areas, plus external converted-resource precaching.
- Configurable debug pause shortcut, slow motion, recorded-video replay, and action effect-slot workflows with attachment information. Recorded-video reverse playback is separate from live simulation.
- In-game file browsing and export dialogs, folder double-click navigation, selection shortcuts, a draggable/resizable editor and a screen-edge restore orb.
- An MCP server for AI-assisted inspection and editing. See the repository's Chinese and English tutorials before applying changes.

Changes made for live preview are temporary unless explicitly exported. Export locations are chosen by the user. Game updates, effect types and particular motion/PFB relationships can affect behavior; an offline installer check does not replace an in-game check of your own files.

## Verification

This release is rebuilt from the published source with .NET SDK 10.0.300 and includes .NET runtime 10.0.8. SHA256 sidecars, build metadata, and the actual isolated-installer check report are attached. It is not byte-identical to the earlier local build. CI does not use proprietary game fixtures, run the previous six-version upgrade matrix, or launch the game. See [build and release details](https://github.com/wzj3196138722-ux/RE-MotionVfxStudio/blob/main/.github/README_BUILD_RELEASE.md).

## 中文说明

MotionVfx Live 是用于《**怪物猎人 荒野**》的游戏内动作与特效编辑器，提供 REFramework-D2D 界面和 AI MCP 接口。

下载下方 **`MotionVfxLive-0.8.5-Setup.exe`**。先退出游戏，运行安装器，选择包含 `MonsterHunterWilds.exe` 的游戏目录。需要预先安装可正常使用的 REFramework；编辑器、D2D、输入组件、MCP 和 .NET 运行库均已包含，不需要额外安装开发 SDK、Python 或 .NET。

支持直接更新旧版，同版本可修复安装。替换前会备份，仅清理能通过旧包清单及哈希确认的旧程序文件；保留素材、导出、设置、备注、其他 MOD、不明来源文件和用户改过的文件，不替换 REFramework 本体。

功能包括角色真实动作与特效记录、特效块及参数编辑、游戏内应用预览、XY/XYZ 和颜色组合编辑、属性中英文显示、Group 备注、块及属性删除、独立 PFB 区、外部游戏格式素材预缓存、暂停快捷键和慢放、录制画面回放、动作特效槽位及挂点选择。倒放针对已录制画面，不是把游戏模拟时间调成负值。

文件选择和导出使用游戏内弹窗，支持双击文件夹与常用选择操作；主界面支持拖动、缩放和悬浮球恢复。AI 操作前请阅读仓库中的中英文教程。游戏内试改在未导出时只用于当前预览，导出位置由用户选择。游戏更新、特效类型及动作/PFB 对应关系可能影响使用效果，需要结合自己的文件在游戏内验证。

本 Release 是公开源码重新构建的文件，与之前本地交付包的哈希不同。附件包含对应 SHA256、构建信息和真实安装自检结果。CI 只在模拟目录测试，不含真实游戏 EFX，不代表重新跑过旧六版本升级矩阵，也没有启动游戏。
